title: symphyotrichum retroflexum
intro: Symphyotrichum retroflexum, commonly known as Joe-Pye weed, is a perennial plant native to North America. It is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving rheumatism, and treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Joe-Pye weed include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, making it a popular treatment for coughs and congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
